extended:
**On a volume invariant of 3-manifolds** — Marc Kegel, Arunima Ray, Jonathan Spreer, Em Thompson, Stephan Tillmann.

Introduces the **topological volume** vol_t(M): for a 3-manifold M, the smallest volume of the complement of a (possibly empty) hyperbolic link in M. Gives refinements of the invariant, asymptotically tight upper and lower bounds, and classifies all non-hyperbolic closed 3-manifolds with topological volume at most 3.07.

**Why it may bear here.** A volume invariant defined for *non-hyperbolic* manifolds is exactly the gap this corpus hits when a knot is non-hyperbolic and its hyperbolic volume is zero (the trefoil case). Whether that gap is the one this invariant fills is unexamined.
